page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 instance running on a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system provides 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs using dedicated CPU allocation. Memory capacity is 32.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. Cache specifications include 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. The instance has no integrated local storage and no GPU accelerators. Baseline network throughput is rated at 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-to-mid-tier relative performance for this instance hardware profile. Single-core performance registered a stress-ng score of 1103.79 and a Geekbench score of 935.0. Multi-core performance achieved a Passmark CPU score of 6968.94 and a stress-ng score of 5859.67. Uncached 256MB memory write bandwidth reached 34.64 GB/sec, while uncached read bandwidth recorded 38.97 GB/sec. Small 135M parameter LLM inference yields 464.1 prompt tokens/sec and 98.99 generation tokens/sec, though performance decreases to 4.84 generation tokens/sec on 7B models. The lack of local storage requires network-attached cloud storage for persistent data.

With its standard resource ratio, the ecs.g5ne.2xlarge offers balanced resource allocation without dedicated high-speed local disk hardware. Recommended applications include standard web serving, backend microservices, light data processing, small software compilation pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise application hosting.

The server lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and providing a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. CPU instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA extensions. The instance profile is suited for general-purpose workloads, microservices, static web hosting, and light utility software deployment.
